invariants: The complete declared stdio/HTTP list is validated before mounting any provider; selected original normalized names, config/defaults, environment/header fields and exact indexed errors match the native mapping.

MCP providers are activated in the unpublished Agent scope after model control installation and before factory Agent/Session publication; siblings may reuse the same server namespace without global tool leakage.

Actual ToolsService consumers preserve the raw MCP value and model-facing content; session close removes registrations and waits for child exit, while resume mounts fresh request declarations rather than restoring stale processes.
Later invalid declarations spawn no peer, later startup failure drains already mounted peers, and caller or bridge abort cannot publish a late completed setup.

Initialize advertises the original HTTP MCP capability, and actual canonical ACP/embedded Portable processes execute stdio/HTTP tools through a local model consumer with preserved workspace/environment/headers and proved child exit.
identity: One requested normalized server namespace per exact Agent scope and one fresh provider generation per new/resume declaration; no cross-session or global registry ownership.
ownership: The unpublished Agent factory scope owns each sequentially mounted MCP plugin, process, pending request and tool registration; the ACP request owns declarations and cancellation, and the controlled observer owns local fixtures.
ordering: Full list validation precedes the first mount; model control precedes MCP activation; every requested mount settles before publication. Cancellation during blocked initialization waits for plugin apply to finish before Cordis effect disposal, as observed at an explicit late-handshake release barrier.
errors: Caller-correctable mapping failures preserve AcpMcpConfigError and exact indexed source messages and become ACP Invalid params; connection/startup errors remain startup failures and roll back the owned scope.
cancellation: Unpublished setup abort prevents Agent/Session publication and reaps real children after the declared late initialization release; this contract does not claim immediate disposal of an indefinitely unresponsive initializer before the SDK default timeout.
adaptation: Python 3.8 setup returns an awaitable when declarations are nonempty, preserving synchronous compatibility for existing empty-list factory adapters; the production factory awaits it. The installation-owned plugin registry resolves the provider. Windows child-exit observation uses Win7-compatible process synchronization handles.
open_questions: Main frozen development preview passed complete regression, current original/paired gates and actual extracted Portable; clean committed acceptance remains pending. The 58 mapped declaration cases and selected cancellation barrier do not certify complete WHATWG URL/Unicode behavior, infinite blocked initialization, full SDK HTTP, subprocess subagent-acp or overall ACP; Win7 execution remains deferred by the user.
